method: Incidence = pooled time-loss injuries / pooled exposure hours × 1,000.
Burden = pooled days lost / pooled exposure hours × 1,000.
Season-attributed undated injuries are included in counts and breakdowns but excluded from monthly series.
Match exposure = registered fixtures in the season window × 15 players × 80 minutes / 60 per team.
Training exposure = included curated exposure in the season window minus match exposure.
IOC-aligned body-location and tissue/pathology categories use the accepted mappings.
Injury rows and values are restated from the reviewed 2024-25 master workbook and its ordered decision ledger.

headline.label: Recorded injuries
headline.formula: count(eligible injury rows in registered season window, including season-attributed undated rows)

headline.label: Time-loss injuries
headline.formula: count(eligible injury rows where days lost > 0)

headline.label: Incidence
headline.formula: pooled time-loss injuries / pooled exposure hours * 1000

headline.label: Mean severity
headline.formula: pooled days lost / pooled time-loss injuries

headline.label: Median severity
headline.formula: median(days lost) across pooled time-loss injuries

headline.label: Burden
headline.formula: pooled days lost / pooled exposure hours * 1000

limitations: The registered season window, rather than team-specific exposure coverage, defines both numerator and denominator eligibility.
Season-attributed undated injuries are retained in counts and breakdowns but cannot be month-plotted.
Unknown-setting injuries are included in overall metrics but have no match/training rate.
Exact diagnoses are not inferred; accepted IA-02/ACL-01 reporting classification is applied separately.
Superseded database-side injury cleaning is retired; the reviewed master-plus-ledger lineage is the authoritative injury record.

prior_season.note: No Glasgow Warriors prior-season injury and exposure denominator pair exists in this V2 workspace, so the dashboard leaves comparison blank rather than mixing in legacy report figures.

analysis_window.basis: Registered season window; no team exposure-window restriction.
